ayahs.ar: وَٱلذَّٰرِيَـٰتِ ذَرْوًا
ayahs.en: By those that winnow with a winnowing

ayahs.ar: فَٱلْحَـٰمِلَـٰتِ وِقْرًا
ayahs.en: And those that bear the burden (of the rain)

ayahs.ar: فَٱلْجَـٰرِيَـٰتِ يُسْرًا
ayahs.en: And those that glide with ease (upon the sea)

ayahs.ar: فَٱلْمُقَسِّمَـٰتِ أَمْرًا
ayahs.en: And those who distribute (blessings) by command,

ayahs.ar: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَصَادِقٌ
ayahs.en: Lo! that wherewith ye are threatened is indeed true,

ayahs.ar: وَإِنَّ ٱلدِّينَ لَوَٰقِعٌ
ayahs.en: And lo! the judgment will indeed befall.

ayahs.ar: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلْحُبُكِ
ayahs.en: By the heaven full of paths,

ayahs.ar: إِنَّكُمْ لَفِى قَوْلٍ مُّخْتَلِفٍ
ayahs.en: Lo! ye, forsooth, are of various opinion (concerning the truth).

ayahs.ar: يُؤْفَكُ عَنْهُ مَنْ أُفِكَ
ayahs.en: He is made to turn away from it who is (himself) averse.

ayahs.ar: قُتِلَ ٱلْخَرَّٰصُونَ
ayahs.en: Accursed be the conjecturers

ayahs.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى غَمْرَةٍ سَاهُونَ
ayahs.en: Who are careless in an abyss!

ayahs.ar: يَسْـَٔلُونَ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
ayahs.en: They ask: When is the Day of Judgment?

ayahs.ar: يَوْمَ هُمْ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ يُفْتَنُونَ
ayahs.en: (It is) the day when they will be tormented at the Fire,

ayahs.ar: ذُوقُوا۟ فِتْنَتَكُمْ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
ayahs.en: (And it will be said unto them): Taste your torment (which ye inflicted). This is what ye sought to hasten.

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
ayahs.en: Lo! those who keep from evil will dwell amid gardens and watersprings,

ayahs.ar: ءَاخِذِينَ مَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَبْلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُحْسِنِينَ
ayahs.en: Taking that which their Lord giveth them; for lo! aforetime they were doers of good;

ayahs.ar: كَانُوا۟ قَلِيلًا مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ مَا يَهْجَعُونَ
ayahs.en: They used to sleep but little of the night,

ayahs.ar: وَبِٱلْأَسْحَارِ هُمْ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ
ayahs.en: And ere the dawning of each day would seek forgiveness,

ayahs.ar: وَفِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِهِمْ حَقٌّ لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلْمَحْرُومِ
ayahs.en: And in their wealth the beggar and the outcast had due share.

ayahs.ar: وَفِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ءَايَـٰتٌ لِّلْمُوقِنِينَ
ayahs.en: And in the earth are portents for those whose faith is sure.

ayahs.ar: وَفِىٓ أَنفُسِكُمْ ۚ أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ
ayahs.en: And (also) in yourselves. Can ye then not see?

ayahs.ar: وَفِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ رِزْقُكُمْ وَمَا تُوعَدُونَ
ayahs.en: And in the heaven is your providence and that which ye are promised;

ayahs.ar: فَوَرَبِّ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ إِنَّهُۥ لَحَقٌّ مِّثْلَ مَآ أَنَّكُمْ تَنطِقُونَ
ayahs.en: And by the Lord of the heavens and the earth, it is the truth, even as (it is true) that ye speak.

ayahs.ar: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ضَيْفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ ٱلْمُكْرَمِينَ
ayahs.en: Hath the story of Abraham's honoured guests reached thee (O Muhammad)?

ayahs.ar: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوا۟ سَلَـٰمًا ۖ قَالَ سَلَـٰمٌ قَوْمٌ مُّنكَرُونَ
ayahs.en: When they came in unto him and said: Peace! he answered, Peace! (and thought): Folk unknown (to me).

ayahs.ar: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ فَجَآءَ بِعِجْلٍ سَمِينٍ
ayahs.en: Then he went apart unto his housefolk so that they brought a fatted calf;

ayahs.ar: فَقَرَّبَهُۥٓ إِلَيْهِمْ قَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ
ayahs.en: And he set it before them, saying: Will ye not eat?

ayahs.ar: فَأَوْجَسَ مِنْهُمْ خِيفَةً ۖ قَالُوا۟ لَا تَخَفْ ۖ وَبَشَّرُوهُ بِغُلَـٰمٍ عَلِيمٍ
ayahs.en: Then he conceived a fear of them. They said: Fear not! and gave him tidings of (the birth of) a wise son.

ayahs.ar: فَأَقْبَلَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُهُۥ فِى صَرَّةٍ فَصَكَّتْ وَجْهَهَا وَقَالَتْ عَجُوزٌ عَقِيمٌ
ayahs.en: Then his wife came forward, making moan, and smote her face, and cried: A barren old woman!

ayahs.ar: قَالُوا۟ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
ayahs.en: They said: Even so saith thy Lord. Lo! He is the Wise, the Knower.

ayahs.ar: ۞ قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
ayahs.en: (Abraham) said: And (afterward) what is your errand, O ye sent (from Allah)?

ayahs.ar: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ أُرْسِلْنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍ مُّجْرِمِينَ
ayahs.en: They said: Lo! we are sent unto a guilty folk,

ayahs.ar: لِنُرْسِلَ عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةً مِّن طِينٍ
ayahs.en: That we may send upon them stones of clay,

ayahs.ar: مُّسَوَّمَةً عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُسْرِفِينَ
ayahs.en: Marked by thy Lord for (the destruction of) the wanton.

ayahs.ar: فَأَخْرَجْنَا مَن كَانَ فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.en: Then we brought forth such believers as were there.

ayahs.ar: فَمَا وَجَدْنَا فِيهَا غَيْرَ بَيْتٍ مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
ayahs.en: But We found there but one house of those surrendered (to Allah).

ayahs.ar: وَتَرَكْنَا فِيهَآ ءَايَةً لِّلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ
ayahs.en: And We left behind therein a portent for those who fear a painful doom.

ayahs.ar: وَفِى مُوسَىٰٓ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَـٰهُ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ
ayahs.en: And in Moses (too, there is a portent) when We sent him unto Pharaoh with clear warrant,

ayahs.ar: فَتَوَلَّىٰ بِرُكْنِهِۦ وَقَالَ سَـٰحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ
ayahs.en: But he withdrew (confiding) in his might, and said: A wizard or a madman.

ayahs.ar: فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُ وَجُنُودَهُۥ فَنَبَذْنَـٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌ
ayahs.en: So We seized him and his hosts and flung them in the sea, for he was reprobate.

ayahs.ar: وَفِى عَادٍ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلرِّيحَ ٱلْعَقِيمَ
ayahs.en: And in (the tribe of) A'ad (there is a portent) when we sent the fatal wind against them.

ayahs.ar: مَا تَذَرُ مِن شَىْءٍ أَتَتْ عَلَيْهِ إِلَّا جَعَلَتْهُ كَٱلرَّمِيمِ
ayahs.en: It spared naught that it reached, but made it (all) as dust.

ayahs.ar: وَفِى ثَمُودَ إِذْ قِيلَ لَهُمْ تَمَتَّعُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
ayahs.en: And in (the tribe of) Thamud (there is a portent) when it was told them: Take your ease awhile.

ayahs.ar: فَعَتَوْا۟ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّـٰعِقَةُ وَهُمْ يَنظُرُونَ
ayahs.en: But they rebelled against their Lord's decree, and so the thunderbolt overtook them even while they gazed;

ayahs.ar: فَمَا ٱسْتَطَـٰعُوا۟ مِن قِيَامٍ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُنتَصِرِينَ
ayahs.en: And they were unable to rise up, nor could they help themselves.

ayahs.ar: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍ مِّن قَبْلُ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمًا فَـٰسِقِينَ
ayahs.en: And the folk of Noah aforetime. Lo! they were licentious folk.

ayahs.ar: وَٱلسَّمَآءَ بَنَيْنَـٰهَا بِأَيْي۟دٍ وَإِنَّا لَمُوسِعُونَ
ayahs.en: We have built the heaven with might, and We it is Who make the vast extent (thereof).

ayahs.ar: وَٱلْأَرْضَ فَرَشْنَـٰهَا فَنِعْمَ ٱلْمَـٰهِدُونَ
ayahs.en: And the earth have We laid out, how gracious is the Spreader (thereof)!

ayahs.ar: وَمِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَا زَوْجَيْنِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ
ayahs.en: And all things We have created by pairs, that haply ye may reflect.

ayahs.ar: فَفِرُّوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُم مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
ayahs.en: Therefor flee unto Allah; lo! I am a plain warner unto you from him.

ayahs.ar: وَلَا تَجْعَلُوا۟ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُم مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
ayahs.en: And set not any other god along with Allah; lo! I am a plain warner unto you from Him.

ayahs.ar: كَذَٰلِكَ مَآ أَتَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا قَالُوا۟ سَاحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ
ayahs.en: Even so there came no messenger unto those before them but they said: A wizard or a madman!

ayahs.ar: أَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِهِۦ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ طَاغُونَ
ayahs.en: Have they handed down (the saying) as an heirloom one unto another? Nay, but they are froward folk.

ayahs.ar: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِمَلُومٍ
ayahs.en: So withdraw from them (O Muhammad), for thou art in no wise blameworthy,

ayahs.ar: وَذَكِّرْ فَإِنَّ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ تَنفَعُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.en: And warn, for warning profiteth believers.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا خَلَقْتُ ٱلْجِنَّ وَٱلْإِنسَ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُونِ
ayahs.en: I created the jinn and humankind only that they might worship Me.

ayahs.ar: مَآ أُرِيدُ مِنْهُم مِّن رِّزْقٍ وَمَآ أُرِيدُ أَن يُطْعِمُونِ
ayahs.en: I seek no livelihood from them, nor do I ask that they should feed Me.

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلرَّزَّاقُ ذُو ٱلْقُوَّةِ ٱلْمَتِينُ
ayahs.en: Lo! Allah! He it is that giveth livelihood, the Lord of unbreakable might.

ayahs.ar: فَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ ذَنُوبًا مِّثْلَ ذَنُوبِ أَصْحَـٰبِهِمْ فَلَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونِ
ayahs.en: And lo! for those who (now) do wrong there is an evil day like unto the evil day (which came for) their likes (of old); so let them not ask Me to hasten on (that day).

ayahs.ar: فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن يَوْمِهِمُ ٱلَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ
ayahs.en: And woe unto those who disbelieve, from (that) their day which they are promised.
